purpose: Research-first build queue for MeshyAnts. Every implementation task must produce evidence, survive critique, and compare against a simpler baseline.
global_done_gate: stable scorecard recorded with no unexplained regression

tasks.title: Lock the V2 experiment contract
tasks.hypothesis: A small, explicit experiment contract will prevent MeshyAnts from becoming an unfalsifiable agent framework.
success_criteria: single-agent, manager-worker, central-router and MeshyAnts runs can be compared under the same budget
another agent can run the benchmark without inventing rules

tasks.title: Define worker phenotype and lifecycle
tasks.hypothesis: Versioned worker phenotypes plus explicit task/lease/checkpoint states are enough to support reproducible experiments without adding a heavy orchestrator.
success_criteria: worker identity is reproducible
stale workers cannot overwrite current work
deterministic tools and LLM workers fit the same abstraction

tasks.title: Build baseline benchmark harness
tasks.hypothesis: MeshyAnts is only meaningful if it can beat or complement strong simpler baselines.
success_criteria: same tasks/models/tools/budget can run through every baseline
results are machine-readable

tasks.title: Implement minimum Meshy allocation experiment
tasks.hypothesis: Local eligibility + thresholds + contextual reputation + stochastic claiming can outperform central routing in some heterogeneous workloads.
success_criteria: no LLM is used for task claiming
routing decisions are replayable
at least one benchmark regime tests the hypothesis

tasks.title: Topology experiments
tasks.hypothesis: Modular local neighborhoods with sparse integration and recurrence can outperform a flat global field on quality or coordination cost.
success_criteria: same worker set can run under multiple topologies
topology is a configuration, not hard-coded business logic

tasks.title: Performance and scalability torture suite
tasks.hypothesis: Locality, cheap event-driven coordination and bounded wakeups can scale without global sniffing or runaway compute.
success_criteria: measure 1/10/100/1000 worker simulations where practical
identify scaling knee
prove or falsify that coordination overhead stays bounded enough to matter

tasks.title: NeuroAI research watch and translation loop
tasks.cadence: run when the project reaches a design fork, after a major experiment, or when notable NeuroAI/connectomics work appears; do not churn weekly for no reason
tasks.hypothesis: NeuroAI can supply testable mechanisms, but biological analogy should only enter MeshyAnts when converted into a falsifiable software experiment.
sources: Princeton Natural & Artificial Minds / Princeton Neuroscience Institute
success_criteria: each adopted idea names a measurable prediction
podcasts/transcripts are treated as leads, not evidence when a paper/source exists

tasks.title: Skeptic and evaluator gauntlet
tasks.hypothesis: A machine-checked evaluator report can reject work, require a strongest simpler explanation, and turn negatives into task drafts. It does not replace independent scientific judgment; it blocks rubber stamps, buried negatives, and done-without-evidence.
success_criteria: evaluators can reject work
critic must propose the strongest simpler explanation
negative findings create tasks instead of being buried
evidence_required: evaluation reports attached to material changes

tasks.title: Community and ant ecosystem design
tasks.hypothesis: A portable worker/skill manifest and reproducible eval history could let outsiders contribute useful ants without turning the project into an unsafe plugin marketplace.
success_criteria: a third party can define an ant without changing core code
performance claims require reproducible evidence
marketplace is optional, not assumed

tasks.title: WOW outcome: self-discovered useful workflow
tasks.hypothesis: The strongest demo is not 'many agents ran'; it is that MeshyAnts discovers or adapts a workflow that a fixed orchestrator was not explicitly given, and does so with measurable value.
target: new useful task/path emerges from local signals
workflow survives a worker failure or workload shift
beats a credible baseline on at least one meaningful axis: quality, cost, latency, adaptation or resilience
success_criteria: result is reproducible
baseline is public
failure cases are shown
demo explains why topology/feedback/learning mattered

tasks.title: Publishable findings and community loop
tasks.hypothesis: Open negative and positive results are more valuable than marketing a generic harness.
deliverables: public benchmark dataset where licensing permits
success_criteria: outsider can reproduce at least one key result
claims clearly distinguish observation from speculation

loop_policy.stall_approaching: total score improves by <2 points across 2 rounds OR same material blocker appears twice
loop_policy.stalled: one deliberate architectural rethink fails to improve the result
loop_policy.falsified: simpler system matches/beats claimed advantage or mechanism fails ablation
